SELECT 
    (SELECT substr(r_reason_desc,1,20) FROM reason WHERE r_reason_sk = wr_reason_sk) AS reason_desc,
    AVG(ws_quantity) AS avg_ws_quantity,
    AVG(wr_refunded_cash) AS avg_wr_refunded_cash,
    AVG(wr_fee) AS avg_wr_fee
FROM 
    (SELECT ws_item_sk, ws_order_number, ws_sales_price, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
     FROM web_sales ws
     JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
     WHERE ws.ws_sold_date_sk = (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1998)
       AND (cd.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Primary' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00
            OR cd.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd.cd_education_status = 'College' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00
            OR cd.cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' AND ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00)) fws
JOIN 
    (SELECT wr_reason_sk, wr_refunded_cash, wr_fee
     FROM web_returns wr
     WHERE wr.wr_returned_date_sk = (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_year = 1998)) fwr ON fws.ws_item_sk = fwr.wr_item_sk AND fws.ws_order_number = fwr.wr_order_number
JOIN 
    web_page fp ON fp.wp_web_page_sk = fws.ws_web_page_sk
JOIN 
    customer_address ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = fws.ws_bill_addr_sk
WHERE 
    (fws.cd_marital_status = 'D' AND fws.cd_education_status = 'Primary' AND fws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00)
    OR (fws.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND fws.cd_education_status = 'College' AND fws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00)
    OR (fws.cd_marital_status = 'U' AND fws.cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree' AND fws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00)
GROUP BY 
    reason_desc
ORDER BY 
    reason_desc, avg_ws_quantity, avg_wr_refunded_cash, avg_wr_fee
LIMIT 100
